title: Timer-M1: A Multivariate Time Series Foundation Model via Learning Primitives
note: Abstract page, v1 only (2026-10-08), Zhang et al. (Long group). Pretrained multivariate zero-shot forecaster; channels get roles: target, past-only covariate, known-future covariate. Paper licence CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.

title: Timer-M1: A Multivariate Time Series Foundation Model via Learning Primitives (full text)
note: Pretraining: real series from TimeBench (cited to the Sundial paper) plus synthetic primitive generators; 227 dataset entries.
